travel.image_caption: An auto rickshaw (file photo) — Delhi’s DURGA E-Auto Scheme will roll out 1,300 pink electric autos driven by women and transgender drivers in its first phase.
travel.nri_angle: For the diaspora visiting Delhi, the pink DURGA-branded e-autos will become a recognizable, safer last-mile option; for families in the capital, the scheme opens a path to vehicle ownership for women and transgender relatives.

travel.title: Electric Blue Waves: Chennai's Beaches Are Glowing — Here's How to Catch It
travel.excerpt: Surfers and fishermen report the sea lighting up electric blue off Kovalam and Thiruvanmiyur this month. The plankton behind it is unpredictable — but here's when and where to look.
travel.image_caption: Bioluminescent waves glow electric blue at night. Chennai's beaches have been lighting up with the plankton phenomenon — here's how to catch it.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs visiting Chennai this winter can catch the glow at Kovalam or Thiruvanmiyur in the pre-dawn hours — a rare, free, magical reason to plan a late-night beach trip during the monsoon months.

travel.title: Inside a Restored 1949 Lucknow Heritage Home Where Slow Living Takes Centre Stage
travel.excerpt: Digital creator Geetika Chakravarti's tour of her family's 1949 Lucknow residence — restored by her parents 11 years ago — is a love letter to verandahs, jali cutouts and unhurried mornings.

travel.nri_angle: For NRIs planning roots trips to Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow's restored heritage homes — and the growing heritage-stay category — offer a way to live the slow aesthetic rather than just photograph it.

carousel.title: DHS Proposes Ending Deference to Prior H-1B and L-1 Petition Approvals
carousel.excerpt: A proposed rule would remove the requirement that USCIS defer to earlier I-129 approvals, exposing H-1B and L-1 extensions and amendments to fresh adjudication, more evidence requests, and higher denial risk.
carousel.image_caption: The US Department of Homeland Security headquarters in Washington, DC. DHS has proposed ending automatic deference to prior H-1B and L-1 petition approvals.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian nationals are a large share of H-1B holders and file repeated extensions while awaiting green cards, so losing deference to prior approvals would make renewals less predictable for workers and employers.

carousel.image_caption: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar. Jaishankar said normal ties with China require a stable border.

carousel.title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Now Builds Word, Excel and PowerPoint Replicas
carousel.excerpt: Brandon Thomas's WordCraft, GridCraft and DeckCraft are free, open-source Rust replicas built with Claude - impressive in scope, but still alpha software at roughly half to three-fifths real-work readiness.
carousel.nri_angle: Diaspora professionals who rely on Office get a free, cross-platform alternative to test on copies of files, with clear parity figures showing why it is not yet a replacement for critical work.

carousel.title: Bank Earnings Kick Off Mixed: JPMorgan Misses, Citi and Goldman Beat
carousel.excerpt: JPMorgan posted its first earnings miss in 17 quarters as expenses climbed 12%, while Goldman Sachs rode a trading surge to the second-best revenue quarter in its history and Citigroup delivered its strongest third-quarter revenue in a decade.
carousel.image_caption: A JPMorgan office tower at dusk, showing the bank's illuminated sign. JPMorgan Chase reported third-quarter earnings on Tuesday, missing analyst estimates for the first time in 17 quarters.
carousel.nri_angle: US bank earnings set the tone for the markets where diaspora investors hold brokerage and retirement accounts; the season opened with trading strength offset by rising costs and credit provisions.
